revision_summary: One quote-check failure must be fixed: script_coverage[11] (appointment_set) cites customer_quote 'We could do 4PM tomorrow.' at ts 04:44, but that line actually occurs at ~06:02, after the rep offers an evening alternative at 05:49. The 04:44 ts should retain the rep's actual line ('We can have someone give you a call as soon as tomorrow morning.') and the 4PM confirmation should be re-timestamped to 06:02 or folded into the existing 06:04 entry in trajectory_verdict.grounded_examples, which already has this right. Additionally: (1) re-anchor the objection_inversion_miss cherry-pick moment (02:20) to bill_anchoring instead — the rate-hike comment precedes the bill capture and isn't a customer objection being flipped, so citing coaching_philosophy.objection_inversion misapplies the schema; (2) re-tag the 'enthusiasm_signal' cherry-pick moment (05:00, email request) away from cross_sell_signals, which is reserved for roofing/battery/non-solar-service needs — use a generic engagement/documentation-preference label instead; (3) fix the rep_intent evidence quote at 03:40 to point to the actual pivot instruction at 03:31 ('Actually, if you just read the numbers off the graph...') rather than the stumbling interruption fragment; (4) reconsider trajectory_verdict.shape — 'energy_built' isn't well supported by a flat, already-cooperative call; consider 'sustained_cooperative' or similar; (5) add the missed button_up time-anchor drift (05:39, rep says 30-40 minutes vs. schema's stated one-hour block) as a schema-drift flag, consistent with how the credit-threshold drift was handled elsewhere; (6) optionally surface the mild duplicate-outreach complaint at 01:11 as a friction_resolution_speed moment, since the rep normalized rather than resolved it.
